references.access: Read via Jina; medial-view diagram actually viewed.

references.license: Reference-only observation; no article text or image copied into assets.

preflight.decision: Use installed Blender 5.0.1 native armatures, vertex groups, NLA clips and glTF 2.0 exporter rather than custom rig/format infrastructure.

preflight.status: Read successful current license page; core assets CC0, program code GPL/AGPL.
preflight.decision: Viable permissive base meshes considered, not downloaded: replacing all six authored identities would add proportion/costume rework and dependencies. Original existing native geometry was the smaller complete solution.
Current game was 2D HTML/SVG, no existing 3D renderer. Add established local WebGL2/GLTFLoader/AnimationMixer, retaining authoritative engine, CSS effects, audio and arena artwork.
